100% Local Browser Processing

Privacy Policy — Local Browser File Processing

Your embroidery design files never leave your computer. Here is exactly how local browser parsing, saved settings, and cookieless analytics work.

1. Design Files Never Leave Your Device

When you drag and drop or select a Tajima (.dst) or Brother (.pes) embroidery file on any page of this site, the file is read exclusively inside your web browser using a local JavaScript Web Worker and HTML5 Canvas.

  • No file uploads: No network request ever transmits your embroidery file, stitch coordinates, design label, or preview image to any server.
  • Offline-capable parsing: Once the page has loaded in your browser, you can disconnect from the internet and continue reading .dst and .pes files and calculating quotes.

2. Saved Rate Settings Stay in Your Browser

When you customize your shop rate settings (such as rate per 1,000 stitches, per-piece fee, minimum charge, quantity breaks, garment markup, and machine speed), those numbers are stored locally on your device using your browser's localStorage under the key embroidery_pricer_settings_v1.

  • Your rates are never sent to a server or database.
  • You can clear your saved rates at any time by clicking Reset rates to starting defaults inside the tool or clearing site data in your browser.
  • If your browser blocks localStorage (for example, in strict private browsing mode), the calculator continues working normally using session memory.

3. No Cookies and No Ad Trackers

This site does not set tracking cookies, does not run advertising networks or retargeting pixels, and does not sell or share personal data.

4. What Analytics and the Waitlist Collect

  • Cookieless page counter: In production, this site uses a cookieless, privacy-preserving page counter (such as Cloudflare Web Analytics) to measure aggregate page views, referring websites, country-level region, and browser/screen type without fingerprinting individual users or storing cookies.
  • Optional Paid Version Waitlist: If you choose to click the paid version waitlist link and submit the Google Form, the email address, shop type, and feature preferences you enter on that form are collected solely to notify you about the paid version and prioritize features.
